labeller: blind AI review (Claude), title + one photo + every CPSC recall since 1973 and CPSC's safety warnings

missed.title: Baby Rocker
missed.why: Title only says Baby Rocker, but the photo shows a Fisher-Price tagged inclined sleeper with deep padded mesh sides, a head support, a folding frame and a power cord, the shape of an Auto Rock 'n Play Sleeper, and every Rock 'n Play is recalled.

missed.title: Snuggle Me Gray Baby Pillow Comfortable Infant Support Cushion for Newborns
missed.why: Title says Snuggle Me infant support cushion for newborns and the photo shows the gray padded oval infant lounger; no CPSC recall, but it is an infant lounger.

missed.title: Vtg Raggedy Ann & Andy Express 6-Pc Crib Bedding Set Quilt Sheet Nursery
missed.why: Vintage Raggedy Ann 6-piece crib bedding set whose photo shows long padded panel strips with ties laid beside the quilt, which look like the bumper.

missed.title: Lulyboo PLUS Portable Foldable Bassinet Sleeper Bed, Gray Oval, Handles
missed.why: Lulyboo PLUS soft oval padded baby bed with handles lying on the floor; it is a portable lounger or in-bed sleeper rather than a bassinet on a stand.

missed.title: Raggedy Ann & Andy Crib Bedding Set
missed.why: Raggedy Ann and Andy crib bedding set; the long padded strip with ties at the top of the photo is a crib bumper.

falseAlarms.title: Ingenuity Foldaway Rocking Bassinet used 1
falseAlarms.why: Box reads Ingenuity Foldaway Rocking Bassinet (item 4384), a flat bassinet; it is not on the Kids II rocking sleeper recall list, which names only Rocking Sleepers.

falseAlarms.title: 2-in-1 Graco DuetConnect LX Baby Swing & Portable Bouncer 1
falseAlarms.why: Graco DuetConnect LX swing and bouncer; Graco's swing recalls cover 1990s swings and the 2002-2004 Travel Lite, not the DuetConnect.

falseAlarms.title: Graco baby swing and rocker 1
falseAlarms.why: Graco swing and rocker still packed in its box with a current design; Graco's swing recalls are for 1990s swings and the 2002-2004 Travel Lite, but the title gives no model.

falseAlarms.title: Graco DreamGlider Bassinet Swing 1
falseAlarms.why: Graco DreamGlider gliding swing and bassinet; CPSC has no DreamGlider recall and swings and bassinets are not the risky types.

falseAlarms.title: Baby Bassinet Bedside Crib for Newborn, 4-in-1 Baby Bassinet Bedside 1
falseAlarms.why: Unbranded 4-in-1 bedside bassinet in a stock photo; not a risky type and no brand to match.

falseAlarms.title: Ingenuity Bouncer REPLACEMENT Keep Cozy 3-in-1 Rocker Toy Arch Mobile Elephant
falseAlarms.why: Replacement toy arch for an Ingenuity Keep Cozy 3-in-1 bouncer, circled in the photo; a part only.

falseAlarms.title: 3 in 1 Baby Bassinet, Upgraded Beside Crib with 360 Highly - Scratch & Dent
falseAlarms.why: Unbranded 3-in-1 bedside bassinet in a stock photo; not a risky type and no brand to match.

falseAlarms.title: Plastic Toddler Bed, Disney Princess
falseAlarms.why: Plastic Disney Princess toddler bed; not an infant sleep type and no matching toddler bed recall.

falseAlarms.title: Graco DuetSoothe Swing & Rocker 1
falseAlarms.why: Graco DuetSoothe swing and rocker in the photo; no CPSC recall covers this model.
